title: Best Places to Buy Aluminum Plate Online in 2026: All 9 Compared
summary: Eight places to buy aluminum plate online, compared on pricing, ship dates, cut tolerance, certs, 7050 and minimums, with the job each one fits best. Published by NOX METALS.
body_markdown:
### Where can I buy aluminum plate online?


It depends on the job. For custom-cut certified 6061, 7075 or 7050 plate with a delivered price and ship date before you order, NOX METALS. For small quantities across many metals, OnlineMetals.com. For an AS9100 program, Yarde Metals. For one standard-size piece fast, McMaster-Carr. For thin sheet or diamond plate, Metals Depot.


### Which aluminum supplier is cheapest?


Compare the total delivered cost of your part, not the price per pound. For thick plate and repeat quantities, plate cut close to your finished size usually costs less per finished part because you pay for less metal you machine away. Run the buy-to-fly ratio on your actual part.


### Which suppliers stock 7050 aluminum plate?


NOX METALS, OnlineMetals.com (7050-T7451 up to 8 in, citing AMS 4050) and Yarde Metals list 7050 plate, and McMaster-Carr lists 7050 sheet. Speedy Metals and Metals Depot do not list 7050, and Clinton Aluminum does not feature it.


### Which aluminum supplier gives the fastest delivery?


For standard catalog sizes, McMaster-Carr says most orders arrive same or next day. For cut-to-size plate, NOX METALS shows your ship date with your instant quote, before you order, so you can compare dates before you buy.


### Do I need a certified supplier?


Only if your print or purchase order says so. Shop fixtures, hobby work and most commercial fabrication do not need mill certs, and paying for certified material there is waste. Aerospace, defense and regulated structural work do, and on those jobs a seller with no published certification policy is the wrong tool.
